item.title: French peacekeeper killed in southern Lebanon
item.description: President Macron blames the attack on Hezbollah. The Iran-backed armed group denies "any connection" to the incident.

item.title: Zelensky condemns US extension of Russian sanctions waiver
item.description: The US argues that the waiver is meant to ease the energy supply crunch sparked by the US-Israel war with Iran.

item.title: Chernobyl's last wedding: The couple who married as a nuclear disaster unfolded
item.description: Serhiy and Iryna married 40 years ago, unaware a nuclear reactor had exploded less than 3 miles away.

item.title: Mexico's Sheinbaum denies 'diplomatic crisis' with Spain after conquest row
item.description: The Mexican president says there were never tensions over Spanish colonisation, which had become a thorny issue.
